summary: Today’s tone is broadly risk-on for oil and mixed-to-bearish for gold and large-cap equities, while crypto commentary is leaning selective rather than broadly euphoric. The only clearly sourced fresh analyst call found was a bullish ETH/Bitcoin window from Michael van de Poppe, while market headlines also point to higher oil and softer gold, which supports a cautious macro backdrop.
